{{Quote|For want of a screw a droid was lost,<br />For want of a droid a sensor failed,<br />For want of a sensor a power cell died,<br />For want of a power cell a blaster malfunctioned,<br />For want of a blaster I captured Gavron Noff.<br />Data evaluation and conclusion: Gavron Noff screwed up...|Armx, on his capture of Gavron Noff|<ref name="Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref>}}
'''Gavron Noff''' was a individual who was captured by the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Armx]]. The droid subsequently wrote an epitaph about his capture of Noff.
